texto.es: Revisamos el techo y te damos un estimado claro, sin presión y sin costo escondido.
texto.en: We inspect the roof and give you a clear estimate, no pressure, no hidden cost.

texto.es: Confirmamos fecha y el alcance exacto del trabajo: tear-off, materiales y canaletas si aplica.
texto.en: We confirm the date and the exact scope of work: tear-off, materials and gutters if needed.

texto.es: La cuadrilla llega temprano y se queda hasta terminar. Un techo típico se reemplaza en uno a dos días.
texto.en: The crew arrives early and stays until it is done. A typical roof is replaced in one to two days.

texto.es: Recogemos clavos y escombros, revisamos el trabajo contigo y dejamos la propiedad como la encontramos.
texto.en: We pick up nails and debris, walk the job with you and leave the property the way we found it.

nota.es: Cada techo se cotiza según el tamaño y el material. Escríbenos o llama y te damos el estimado sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every roof is quoted based on size and material. Call or message us and we will walk you through the estimate, no strings attached.

texto.es: Tear-off completo e instalación de shingles o teja, con decking nuevo cuando el original no aguanta.
texto.en: Full tear-off and shingle or tile installation, with new decking when the original cannot hold it.

texto.es: Varios edificios, varias cuadrillas, un solo cronograma. Coordinamos todo para que el complejo quede cubierto a tiempo.
texto.en: Multiple buildings, multiple crews, one schedule. We coordinate everything so the whole complex is covered on time.

texto.es: Reparamos goteras, fascia dañada y áreas puntuales sin necesidad de reemplazar todo el techo.
texto.en: We repair leaks, damaged fascia and specific areas without replacing the whole roof.

texto.es: Instalamos y reparamos skylights y canaletas como parte del mismo proyecto de techo.
texto.en: We install and repair skylights and gutters as part of the same roofing project.

pie.es: Atendemos veteranos con descuento especial. Pregunta al pedir tu estimado.
pie.en: We offer a veterans discount. Ask about it when you request your estimate.

items.quote: hunter got back to me fast, made the inspection easy to schedule, arrived on time, and gave me a fair and honest estimate for the roof replacement and gutter work i needed... the new roof looks great, the gutters came out excellent, and the property was left clean when the work was done.

Hunter and his crew removed and replaced both the house roof and garage roof in just one day, which was amazing considering the amount of work involved... The crew was courteous, skilled, and very professional throughout the entire project.

The estimates were fair, the pricing was reasonable, and we also appreciated the veterans discount on both homes... I highly recommend this company for roof replacement, skylight repairs, and other roofing needs.
